Amazing to see deployed soldiers share a moment with their kids through Beam. Huge thanks to @USArmy @The_USO for helping to make this possible.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Sundar Pichai megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Josh Woodward (@joshwoodward); megjelent: 2026-10-26T22:04:41+00:00; link: https://x.com/joshwoodward/status/2114840668296409568; média: videó, 115 másodperc]
🇺🇸 For a deployed service member, missing family moments adds up. Baby’s first step. The first performance. Sharing a laugh.

In honor of National Day of the Deployed, we’re excited to partner with @USArmy and @The_USO to bring Google Beam to 20 locations so deployed service members can experience lifelike, 3D video connections with their loved ones.
